title: Tanya — Hebrew Wikisource edition
attribution: Tanya, Shneur Zalman of Liadi. Typed Hebrew/Aramaic edition and editorial notes by Hebrew Wikisource contributors, under CC BY-SA4.0. Individual source-page permalinks, revisions and contributor histories are recorded in source-manifest.json; project: https://he.wikisource.org/wiki/%D7%A1%D7%A4%D7%A8_%D7%94%D7%AA%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%90.
changes: Amudi removed only site navigation, image tags and style/script/Parsoid attributes, made source/reference links absolute, and converted the typed source bodies to ordinary reading chapters. All selected reading text, variants, footnotes and source omission markers are retained in exact source order after whitespace normalization. No OCR or newly generated translation. Any copyrightable Amudi adaptation remains CC BY-SA4.0.
coverageScope: All five parts indexed by the selected Hebrew Wikisource edition:53LikkuteiAmarim chapters,12ShaarHaYichudVeHaEmunah chapters,12IggeretHaTeshuvah chapters,32IggeretHaKodesh letters and9KuntresAcharon chapters, plus its two prefatory pages. This is an exact typed-source conservation check, not collation against every printed recension.
